projects.title: Supervised Text Classification Study
bullets: Documented training and test splits for short public text classification in a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Compared classification errors across document lengths using Python, scikit-learn, and pandas for the assigned analysis.

projects.title: Text Classification Course Project
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for short public text documents as part of a supervised graduate course project.
Cleaned public text records and documented training and test splits using Python, scikit-learn, and pandas.
